append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1701). Premise re-tested first (ADR-1082) and measured: with the real bundle, getters, lib/auth and capability loader against a recording fake of the two Supabase clients, a member's circle rail bundle of eight reads made 16 auth.getUser() calls and 65 reads, a janitor's hub bundle of three made 6 and 23. THE FIX: lib/core/action-scope.ts (one AsyncLocalStorage store per runInActionScope call; actionScoped runs a function once per scope per argument list and is a plain call outside one, so page renders keep cache() as before). lib/auth.ts getCachedUser, getCachedViewerProfile and resolveCaller, and load-capabilities currentViewer and viewerEdgeLevel, are cache(actionScoped(...)); the two resolvers share one scoped stewardship read; getCircle/Hub/Nexus/Event/PracticeCapabilities read through an actionScoped memo of the unchanged resolver and hand each caller its own Set copy. getEntityRailBundle runs its reads inside one scope and calls resolveViewerOnce() before the getters start. No getter signature changed: each is a Server Action, so a viewer argument would be client-forgeable. AFTER: 1 getUser and 14 reads (circle), 1 and 9 (hub). components/admin/modules/entity-rail-viewer-once.test.ts holds the count at one, holds each bundled slice equal to its getter called alone for a refused and an admitted viewer with the resolver handed the same viewer fields, and holds two bundles (sequential or in flight together) to their own viewers. The probe replaces the manual one: it loads the scope in process (no test runner, LIVE-034) and checks the bundle, lib/auth and the capability loader are wired through it.
